patterns: APPSC asks direct facts: judicial review borrowed from USA, judicial activism originated in USA, PIL = Social Action Litigation pioneered by Krishna Iyer and Bhagwati, 224A consent of the President.
Strong AP angle: separate AP High Court functioning at Amaravati from 1 Jan 2019, first (acting) CJ C. Praveen Kumar at Vijayawada, AP Reorganisation Act Sec. 30/31/32 match.
APPSC also asks current-affairs court news (HC orders on AP districts/Amaravati, new SC judges, pendency 4.7 crore / 87% subordinate) and 'not an SC evolution' (exemptions to FRs).
Other PSCs favour: retirement 62, resignation to President, President fixes HC strength, court of record (129/215), district judge (Art. 233/236), H.N. Sanyal Committee, PIL in SC and HC.

App MCQs are heavy on Article-number match lists and 3-4 statement sets with 2026 current-affairs items; APPSC is more direct and one-line. Check amendment attributions (139A = 42nd; 43rd restored HC review).
